targets.title: Are we all less risky and more skillful than our fellow drivers?
targets.evidence_quote: We report a preregistered, well-powered (total N = 1,203), very close replication and extension of the Svenson (1981) study.
targets.outcome_quote: Thus, our findings are consistent with the original findings by Svenson (1981).
